security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives from marketing documentation, example URLs, Markdown links, and UTM terminology. The only confirmed issue is the batch CSV helper writing to an unrestricted user-supplied output path. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or network execution intent was found.

remediation.issue: User-controlled CSV output path can overwrite arbitrary writable files.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict output paths to the working directory, reject parent traversal, and require confirmation before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: Implementation guide uses parent-directory Markdown links for bundled reference files.
remediation.suggestion: Replace ../reference and ../examples links with paths relative to the skill root to reduce audit noise and user confusion.

remediation.issue: Documentation does not explicitly state that URL utilities do not fetch remote pages.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short note that the helper only parses and formats URLs and performs no network requests.

content.value_statement: Campaign teams need clear strategy, consistent messaging, and measurable execution across channels. This skill provides structured plans, templates, UTM guidance, and reporting frameworks.
actual_capabilities: Creates campaign briefs with objectives, audience, channels, timeline, and success metrics.
Provides email, landing page, social media, paid ad, and case study templates.
Guides channel selection for email, social media, content marketing, and paid advertising.
Defines KPIs, attribution approaches, dashboard needs, and reporting templates.
Generates, validates, and batch exports UTM tracking URLs through a local Python helper.
limitations: Does not connect to advertising, CRM, email, or analytics platforms automatically.
Requires users to provide current audience data, budgets, offers, and brand rules.
Campaign recommendations are frameworks and need human review before launch.
The helper script can write CSV files and should be run with trusted paths only.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Campaign
use_cases.description: Build a launch brief, channel plan, content themes, and measurement plan for a new product announcement.

use_cases.title: Create a Lead Generation Program
use_cases.description: Plan a lead magnet, landing page, email nurture sequence, and conversion tracking approach.

use_cases.title: Improve Campaign Reporting
use_cases.description: Define campaign KPIs, attribution assumptions, reporting cadence, and dashboard requirements for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Campaign Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign brief for [product] targeting [audience]. Include objective, message, channels, timeline, assets, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Channel Content Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan two weeks of email, social, and blog content for [campaign]. Use [brand voice] and include calls to action.

prompt_templates.title: Build Measurement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a measurement plan for [campaign goal]. Include KPIs, UTM rules, attribution notes, reporting cadence, and dashboard sections.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Weak Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this campaign performance summary: [results]. Identify likely issues, testing priorities, channel changes, and next reporting steps.

output_examples.input: Plan a product launch campaign for a B2B analytics tool.
output: Objective: generate qualified demo requests from operations leaders.
Primary message: replace manual reporting with faster, trusted campaign visibility.
Channels: email to existing list, LinkedIn thought leadership, paid search for high-intent terms, and a conversion landing page.
Measurement: demo requests, conversion rate, cost per lead, qualified lead rate, and influenced pipeline.

output_examples.input: Create reporting guidance for an email nurture campaign.
output: Track open rate, click rate, landing page conversion, unsubscribe rate, and revenue contribution.
Segment results by audience, message theme, and offer type.
Report weekly during launch and monthly after stabilization.

output_examples.input: Improve low social engagement for a campaign.
output: Review whether the message matches audience pain points and platform context.
Test new hooks, clearer visuals, stronger proof points, and narrower audience segments.
Shift budget toward posts with higher saves, comments, and qualified traffic.

best_practices: Provide audience, offer, budget, timeline, and current performance data before requesting a campaign plan.
Review all generated copy for brand voice, legal requirements, and platform rules before publishing.
Use consistent UTM naming and document metric definitions before launch.
anti_patterns: Using the templates without adding real customer insights, proof points, or company context.
Launching across every channel before defining the audience and primary conversion goal.
Treating example benchmarks as targets without adjusting for market, list quality, and budget.

faq.question: Can this skill run marketing campaigns for me?
faq.answer: No. It creates plans, templates, tracking guidance, and analysis frameworks. Users still execute campaigns in their own tools.

faq.question: Does it connect to HubSpot, Mailchimp, or ad platforms?
faq.answer: No. It references common tools for planning and reporting, but it does not authenticate or call external services.

faq.question: Can it create campaign copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates and guidance for emails, landing pages, social posts, ads, and case studies.

faq.question: Can it help with UTM tracking?
faq.answer: Yes. The included helper can generate, validate, and batch export UTM tracking URLs locally.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target audience, product, offer, goal, timeline, budget, channels, brand voice, and existing performance data.

faq.question: Is this suitable for regulated industries?
faq.answer: It can support planning, but all claims, copy, and targeting should receive legal and compliance review before launch.
